name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a rule ('if you reach the exit, the switch must have been flipped first'), so Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard alone is correct. at_exit is only the condition of an 'if', not a commanded goal, so the empty FINAL_STATES and rule-only warning are valid.

texts: If at_exit happens, switch_toggled must have happened before
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
